statements.select:
SELECT FILE_NO, DOC_MGT, DOC_TYPE, FILE_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, FILE_NM, FILE_PATH FROM T_ATTACH_FILE WHERE BIZ_GUBUN = #biz_gubun#
AND CHASU = CONVERT(NUMERIC(18,0),#chasu#)
AND DOC_MGT = #doc_mgt#
AND ISNULL(DOC_MGT,'') = ''
AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY FILE_NO ASC
statements.insert:
SELECT ('FN' + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12),GETDATE(),112),3,2) + dbo.FN_LPAD( CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), CONVERT(INTEGER,( CASE WHEN MAX(FILE_NO) IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE SUBSTRING(MAX(FILE_NO), 5,6) END ) )+1),6,'0') ) AS FILE_NO FROM T_ATTACH_FILE
INSERT INTO T_ATTACH_FILE (COMPANY_CD ,FILE_NO ,BIZ_GUBUN ,CHASU ,DOC_MGT ,DOC_TYPE ,FILE_TYPE ,FILE_PATH ,FILE_SIZE ,FILE_NM ,REG_DT ,REG_USR) VALUES (#company_cd# ,#file_no# ,#biz_gubun# ,#chasu# ,#doc_mgt# ,#doc_type# ,#file_type# ,#file_path# ,#file_size# ,#file_nm# ,getdate() ,#user_cd# )
statements.update: UPDATE T_ATTACH_FILE SET BIZ_GUBUN = #biz_gubun#, CHASU = #chasu#, DOC_MGT = #doc_mgt#, DOC_TYPE = #doc_type#, FILE_TYPE = #file_type#, MOD_DT = getdate(), MOD_USR = #user_cd# WHERE FILE_NO = #file_no# AND COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
statements.delete: UPDATE T_ATTACH_FILE SET USE_YN = 'N' WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND FILE_NO = #file_no#
statements.select: SELECT FILE_NO, FILE_PATH, FILE_TYPE, FILE_NM FROM T_ATTACH_FILE WHERE FILE_NO = #file_no#
